scripts.serve: npm run build && node -e "const h=require('node:http'),f=require('node:fs'),p=require('node:path');h.createServer((q,s)=>{const n=q.url==='/'?'/index.html':q.url.split('?')[0];const t=p.join('public',n);f.readFile(t,(e,d)=>{if(e){s.statusCode=404;return s.end('not found')}s.setHeader('content-type',n.endsWith('.js')?'text/javascript':'text/html');s.end(d)})}).listen(8090,()=>console.log('client on http://127.0.0.1:8090'))"
